import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sqrt(t); s1=np.sqrt(1+t); lP=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*s+p[2]*P+p[3]*P**2+p[4]*P**3
            + s*(p[5]+p[6]*P+p[7]*P**2) + s1*(p[8]*P+p[9]*P*lP))
